axes_source: Read from data/brands/notion.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #5645D4 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #1A1A1A on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #5645D4; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #5645D4 reaches 6.57:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
